mapper.insert: insert into airdrop_record (airdrop_id, user_id, user_coupon_id, create_time) values (#{airdropId}, #{userId}, #{userCouponId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select count(1) > 0 from airdrop_record where airdrop_id = #{airdropId} and user_id = #{userId}
select * from airdrop_record where airdrop_id = #{airdropId} and user_id = #{userId}

select ar.id as id, ar.airdrop_id as airdropId, a.title as airdropTitle, c.name as couponName, c.value as couponValue, ar.create_time as createTime from airdrop_record ar join airdrop a on a.id = ar.airdrop_id join user_coupon uc on uc.id = ar.user_coupon_id join coupon c on c.id = uc.coupon_id where ar.user_id = #{userId} order by ar.create_time desc
